newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.1 pct as mini-band lowered.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.1 pct as mini-band lowered.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.1 percent to close at 1.0316 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency of 1.0315 to 1.0365 per dollar, dealers said.
The Central Bank set the new trading level for the fluctuation of the real by buying dollars at 1.0315 real and selling at 1.0365 reais in a morning auction.
The previous mini-band, set on Nov 20, was between 1.0305 and 1.0355 reais to the dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real fell 0.11 percent to end at 1.0372 to the dollar, following the drop in the mini-band.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.095 per greenback, traders said.
